title: Keep account projects current
responsibility: Refreshes account projects when a device becomes active, without overlapping requests or polling hidden pages.

inputs.name: ProjectSyncService.constructor.options
inputs.description: Provides the refresh callback that reads the signed-in account and its projects, plus an optional polling interval in milliseconds. If omitted, the interval is 30000 ms; the service does not validate its range, and refresh failures are handled by the owner.

outputs.name: sync
outputs.description: Resolves after the active read finishes, including a queued follow-up when sync is called during a read; calls while inactive or hidden resolve immediately. Refresh failures are swallowed, and active visible reads schedule another read after the interval.

outputs.name: ProjectSyncService.start
outputs.description: Activates syncing once, installs focus, online and visibility listeners when the browser objects support them, and waits one interval before the first read while shown. It returns undefined.

outputs.name: ProjectSyncService.stop
outputs.description: Deactivates syncing, clears its timer and queued follow-up, and removes installed listeners; an in-flight refresh is not cancelled. It returns undefined.

outputs.name: ProjectSyncService.sync
outputs.description: Returns the current read promise when active and shown, or an already-resolved promise otherwise; calls during a read queue one subsequent read, and refresh failures are swallowed. Reads do not overlap, and another interval read is scheduled while active and shown.

inputs.name: ProjectSyncService.constructor.options
inputs.description: Provides the refresh callback that reads the signed-in account and its projects, plus an optional polling interval in milliseconds. If omitted, the interval is 30000 ms; the service does not validate its range, and refresh failures are handled by the owner.

outputs.name: ProjectSyncService.constructor
outputs.description: Returns a ProjectSyncService instance configured with the supplied options. Construction does not start reads or install listeners; call start to activate syncing.
